jobs.title: Associate Director, Advanced Analytics & Modeling
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary 
The AD, Advanced Analytics & Modeling (AAM) role will report to Director, AAM in AIDE and help translate priority business decisions into differentiated analytical capabilities, decision-ready evidence, and measurable business & patient impact. This role will lead the modeling capabilities (like KDA, PPM, Precision Health, etc,) and related business analytics to identify the factors influencing business performance and support strategic decision making. The role will partner with the business and cross-functional stakeholders to uncover growth opportunities, quantify key business drivers, generate actionable insights, and measure business impact. The role will also collaborate seamlessly with the I&A and SPT partners – in HYD and EH, and will enable alignment of the core modeling capability ownership, roles and responsibilities, common quality expectations, and effective partnership model with different stakeholders.  
 Job Description 
 Associate Director, Advanced Analytics & Modeling 
 Location – Hyderabad #LI Hybrid  
  
 Major Accountabilities: 
 Advanced Analytics & Modeling Leadership Responsibilities 
 Support the establishment and evolution of the I&A Advanced Analytics & Modeling capability, including its roadmap, maturity agenda, investment priorities, and alignment with portfolio priorities, launches, evolving customer and patient needs, and broader I&A strategy.
 Partner with AAM leadership to assess advanced analytics and ad hoc modeling needs across I&A pillars, prioritize demand, and translate business priorities into clear questions, analytical plans, and modeling agendas while challenging low-value or duplicative requests.
 Determine where analytical and limited ad hoc modeling capabilities should be built, incubated, partnered, automated, reused, or retired based on business value, feasibility, differentiation, maturity, and scalability.
 Deploy AIDE AAM expertise to test, learn, and develop reusable analytical approaches, promoting model reuse, consistency, technical standards, interpretability, human oversight, and responsible use.
 Support KDA and related capability development from problem definition through analysis, insight generation, recommendations, and implementation, including early descriptive and contextual analytics.
 Integrate brand and business context into KDA capabilities, support SPT in scaling reusable data science products, and translate complex analytical outputs into clear business storylines for I&A, senior leadership, and business stakeholders.
 Integrated Partnership with SPT  
 Serve as the AAM point of contact in AIDE/HYD to the SPT Data Science organization for pre-aligned capabilities and initiatives requiring governed data, technical environments, reusable capabilities, productization, integration, deployment, or enterprise scale.
 Partner with I&A and SPT to determine which use cases remain I&A-owned ad hoc analytics versus those transitioning to SPT-owned reusable products, recurring models, engines, or workflows.
 Global US-Hyderabad Operating Model  
 Establish HYD as an integrated capability and delivery partner, engaged early in portfolio planning, business context, analytical design, execution, quality review, synthesis, and capability development.
 Partner with EH leadership to align capability roadmaps, HYD capacity and expertise deployment, decision rights, work ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and talent priorities, while building HYD AAM capability to independently lead repeatable and increasingly complex analytical work with shared accountability for quality, interpretation, and decision impact.
  
 Minimum Requirements: 
 Education: Bachelor s degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business Analytics, or a related field required. 
 Master s degree or doctorate in a relevant quantitative discipline preferred. 
 10 years of leadership experience in advanced analytics, data science, decision science, commercial analytics, healthcare analytics, or a related quantitative field. 
 Proven success in defining and executing an Advanced Analytics strategy and capability roadmap across analytical domains. 
 Deep working and functional knowledge of statistical analysis, predictive analytics, and ML concepts. 
 Strong business acumen with experience supporting commercial, operational, or strategic decision making. 
 Experience leading senior capability owners, flexible expert teams, complex portfolios, and globally distributed analytics organizations. 
 Demonstrated experience applying advanced analytics to consequential commercial, patient, healthcare, launch, or enterprise decisions. 
 Experience in translating complex analyses into actionable business recommendations and executive-level narratives. 
 Experience establishing portfolio prioritization, capacity allocation, quality governance, and reusable capability models. 
 Strong track record partnering with senior business and technology leaders and translating complex analytics into strategic choices and measurable action. 
 Experience leading operating-model transformation, capability centralization or federation, and organizational change. 
   
 Leadership Skills: 
 Lead and deploy HYD talent across AAM priorities, therapeutic areas, and cross-portfolio initiatives, ensuring team members build differentiated technical depth through primary capability affiliation while developing breadth across adjacent domains.
 Own KDA capability talent planning, including hiring, onboarding, goal setting, coaching, performance management, succession, career development, engagement, and retention, while building leadership depth through rotations, communities of practice, and T-shaped skill development.
 Foster a culture of collaboration, constructive challenge, innovation, inclusion, continuous improvement, and accountability across Hyderabad and cross-functional teams.
   
 Required Skills: 
 Strong expertise in Advanced Analytics & Modeling strategy, statistical analysis, predictive analytics, ML fundamentals, capability portfolio leadership, roadmap development, and investment prioritization.
 Broad fluency across predictive modeling, patient analytics, driver analytics, causal inference, experimentation, IPMM, ROI, response curves, optimization, NLP, GenAI, and unstructured analytics, with sound judgment on method fit, evidence quality, validation, interpretability, uncertainty, model risk, and responsible AI.
 Strong executive decision framing, business translation, stakeholder influence, conflict resolution, and portfolio trade-off management, with clear understanding of analytical versus technical ownership across analytics, modeling, products, platforms, and lifecycle management.
 Proficiency in SQL, Excel, Python/Data IKU, large datasets, data preparation, and analytics workflows.
   
 Preferred Experience and Skills: 
 Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, or another complex regulated industry. 
 Experience incubating emerging AI or unstructured-data capabilities and validating use cases before scale. 
 Experience establishing integrated operating models with global capability centers and AI, data, product, or platform organizations. 
  
 Location: Hyderabad NKC | Hybrid | 3 days a week in office is mandatory. 
 Direct Reports : 5 Senior associates along with cross-functional collaboration with 20 associates.
  
 Skills Desired 
Artificial Intelligence (AI), Biostatistics, Business Value Creation, Change Management, Curious Mindset, Data Governance, Data Literacy, Data Quality, Data Science, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Graph Algorithms, Learning Agility, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Algorithms, Python (Programming Language), Stakeholder Engagement, Statistical Analysis, Time Series Analysis

jobs.title: Director, Analytics Excellence & Governance
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary 
The AIDE organization enables Insights & Analytics to create an optimal decision environment for the US business by integrating insights and analytics across therapeutic areas, functions, and the enterprise. The Director, Analytics Excellence and Governance will lead the execution, governance, and continuous evolution of the enterprise analytics capability strategy across Decision Intelligence & Analytics. The role will translate enterprise direction into integrated capability roadmaps, investment priorities, governance frameworks, operating models, and measurable outcomes across patient, customer, field intelligence, analytics modernization, and portfolio management. Serving as the AIDE counterpart to the ED, AEG in East Hanover, the role will co-own the enterprise analytics capability ecosystem and act as the AIDE business owner for field-orchestration analytics. This includes providing strategic direction, executive governance, investment oversight, and SteerCo leadership for analytics, insights, measurement, and decision-support capabilities that enable coordinated field decisions and execution. The role will also partner with SPT on analytics products, platforms, AI solutions, CRM capabilities, and data-enabled decision support, while governing a globally integrated US-HYD capability model through common standards, aligned priorities, shared accountability, and scalable operating practices.  
 Job Description 
 Director, Analytics Excellence & Governance   
 Location – Hyderabad #LI Hybrid  
  
 Major Accountabilities: 
 Enterprise Capability Strategy & Roadmap 
 Translate enterprise analytics strategy into integrated capability priorities, investments, roadmaps, and operating plans.
 Ensure alignment across patient, customer, field, decision intelligence, modernization, data, AI, and technology priorities.
 Design integrated capability roadmaps, resolving cross-capability gaps, overlaps, dependencies, and priorities.
 Continuously evolve the portfolio based on business needs, outcomes, and emerging capabilities.
 Integrated Capability Architecture 
 Establish the business capability architecture connecting intelligence, analytics, decision support, workflows, measurement, and execution.
 Define capability boundaries, ownership, decision rights, and operating-model expectations.
 Ensure analytics domains operate as an integrated ecosystem, promoting scalability, reuse, interoperability, and consistency across brands and therapeutic areas.
 Enterprise Governance & Standards 
 Establish and drive enterprise analytics governance, executive review mechanisms, decision rights, and operating principles across AIDE.
 Set standards for definitions, methodologies, quality, information stewardship, privacy, compliance, risk, and responsible AI, while holding capability leaders accountable for domain governance, lifecycle management, and adoption.
 SPT Partnership  
 Serve as the AIDE counterpart to SPT for analytics products, data capabilities, AI solutions, CRM analytics, and field-orchestration enablement, ensuring capability needs translate into coherent product, data, AI, and technology plans.
 Enable joint governance across roadmaps, investments, capacity, dependencies, issue escalation, and value realization, while resolving key business-to-technology trade-offs and maintaining clear ownership boundaries.
 Analytics Modernization & Operating Model Transformation  
 Set the enterprise direction for analytics modernization, productivity, process re-engineering, and human-plus-agent ways of working, including responsible AI-enabled workflows, reusable patterns, human oversight, and measurable productivity improvements.
 Drive elimination of fragmented, duplicative, manual, and obsolete analytics processes while holding AIDE leaders accountable for adoption, quality improvement, capacity release, and realized value.
 Global Capability Operating Model 
 Help govern the globally integrated operating model across EH and HYD capability teams, establishing expectations for decision rights, shared accountability, governance, workforce planning, and delivery collaboration.
 Partner with AIDE leadership on capability roadmaps, capacity, talent priorities, and operating-model evolution, while driving adoption of common standards, methodologies, reusable assets, and scalable delivery practices.
 Foster a One-Team culture grounded in transparency, trust, knowledge sharing, capability development, and shared outcomes.
 Field-Orchestration Analytics Capability Leadership 
 Provide executive oversight and enterprise governance for analytics and insights capabilities supporting field orchestration, including investment guardrails for field intelligence capabilities.
 Sponsor integrated planning with AIDE Commercial I&A, capability leaders, and SPT, ensuring clear decision rights across business strategy, analytics requirements, decisioning capabilities, and technology ownership.

jobs.title: BI Lab Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description
 
 Ecolab seeks a business-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production-ready solutions.
 
 This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision-making forward.
 In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day-to-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
 
 The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands-on delivery of scaled solution.
 Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.
 
 Key Responsibilities:
 Translate business needs into data-driven solutions Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
 Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value
 
 Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
 Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
 Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity
 
 
 Apply the appropriate analytical approach Determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
 Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).
 
 Perform data transformation and analysis Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage dbt to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.
 
 Design meaningful metrics and outputs Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
 Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.
 
 Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
 Partner cross-functionally to scale solutions into production
 Sometimes contribute to scaled products.
 
 Operate flexibly between guidance and execution Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
 Contribute hands-on development when needed in resource-constrained environments
 
 Drive insight-led decision-making Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
 Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration
 
 Team Leadership Coach direct reports and “dotted line” analysts on ways to improve solution development.
 
 Required Qualifications:
 12 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
 3-5 Years of Direct People Management Experience
 Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
 Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, or prototyping
 Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
 Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
 Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
 Strong problem-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact
 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
 Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using tools such as Streamlit.
 Familiarity with semantic models in Snowflake
 Experience with AI-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
 Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
 Exposure to product-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
 Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
 Experience with GitHub or other CI/CD pipeline tools.
 Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.

jobs.title: Business Performance & Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Supply Chain 
 Job Description 
 Role Summary 
 The Business Performance & Analytics Analyst supports the Global Planning Network and site Supply Chain organizations by delivering business intelligence, analytics, reporting, visualization, financial insights, and digital solutions that enable data-driven decision making across the end-to-end supply chain.
 The role partners with Global Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Digital Technology, and Site Supply Chain Operations to transform operational, planning, and financial data into actionable business insights. This position is responsible for developing enterprise reporting, performance dashboards, planning analytics, KPI scorecards, and automation solutions that improve forecast accuracy, inventory optimization, manufacturing performance, service levels, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
 The analyst also supports continuous improvement initiatives through process standardization, automation, AI-enabled analytics, and self-service reporting capabilities while ensuring data integrity, governance, and compliance.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business Performance & Analytics 
 ·        Develop and maintain enterprise dashboards, KPI scorecards, and performance reporting that support the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organisations.
 ·        Analyse operational, planning, manufacturing, inventory, procurement, logistics and financial data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and performance improvement initiatives.
 ·        Deliver recurring and ad hoc analytics to support Integrated Business Planning (IBP), S&OP, operational reviews, governance forums and executive decision-making.
 ·        Translate complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 ·        Develop executive-level visualisations that improve business visibility and support strategic planning.
 ·        Strong Data Analytics experience (problem-solving and data-to-insight storytelling)
 ·        Python, SQL, and Databricks
 ·        Tableau/Power BI
 ·        Supply Chain domain experience
 Strong experience in data visualization (Tableau/Power BI), with some exposure to Python/Databricks, along with Supply Chain domain experience
  
 2. Planning Network Analytics 
 Provide analytics and reporting support across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning and Integrated Business Planning processes.
 Monitor, analyse and report planning performance metrics including:
   
 Supply Planning 
 Supply / Production Plan Adherence
 Capacity Utilisation and Constraints
 Network Inventory Performance
 Inventory Health and Abnormal Scrap
 Raw Materials Planning 
 Material Availability
 Supplier Performance
 Purchase Order Adherence
 Inventory Health, Ageing, Excess and Obsolete Materials
 Raw Material Supply Risk Indicators
 Partner with planning teams to identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy, inventory optimisation, service levels and supply reliability.
 3. Site Supply Chain Analytics 
 Provide analytics and reporting that support manufacturing execution, inventory management, warehousing, operational planning, inspection readiness and continuous improvement initiatives.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Monitor and report inventory levels across all stages of manufacturing and supply.
 Analyse warehouse utilisation, inventory health and abnormal scrap performance.
 Support operational reviews through the delivery of timely analytics, business insights and performance reporting.
 Manage and maintain key site supply chain reports, dashboards and visualisation tools.
 Generate data extracts and analytics supporting operational reviews, regulatory inspections, business continuity activities and site performance management.
 4. Supply Chain Systems & Digital Solutions 
 Provide functional support and continuous improvement for supply chain systems, data, reporting platforms and system integrations.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Support SAP Supply Chain processes including Warehouse Management (WM), Production Planning (PP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Master Data and Quality Management.
 Provide functional support for SAP GUI transactions, SAP Fiori applications and connected platforms including MES, Maximo and Ariba. 
 Troubleshoot user issues, reporting discrepancies, system errors and interface-related challenges.
 Support user access management, testing activities, documentation, training and user adoption initiatives.
 Partner with Digital Technology, SAP functional and technical teams to implement enhancements, resolve issues and improve system performance.
 Design, develop and maintain reporting and visualisation solutions using Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud or similar platforms. 
 Develop self-service reporting capabilities and automate recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency and business visibility.
 5. Financial Analytics, Continuous Improvement & Automation 
 Support supply chain financial performance while driving process optimisation, automation and data-driven decision making.
 Key responsibilities include:
 Support budgeting, forecasting, accrual management, invoice reconciliation, cost centre management, logistics charges and budget performance tracking.
 Analyse and reconcile operational and financial data to identify cost drivers, forecast spend and assess budget adherence.
 Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to understand financial impacts associated with inventory, manufacturing, logistics and scrap performance.
 Drive process simplification, standardisation and automation initiatives that improve operational efficiency and reporting effectiveness.
 Leverage AI-enabled analytics, predictive insights and digital technologies to enhance business performance and decision-making.
 Improve data quality, governance and reporting consistency across planning and operational processes.
 Support the development of innovative analytics solutions, digital dashboards and enterprise performance measurement capabilities.
 Basic Qualifications 
 Master s degree  OR Bachelor s degree and 5-9 years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, or related business functions.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 ·        Experience supporting Supply Chain Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Operations, or related business functions.
 ·        Knowledge of Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Raw Materials Planning, and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes.
 ·        Experience with SAP platforms (S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, IBP) and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, or BusinessObjects.
 ·        Proficiency in data analytics and reporting tools, including SQL, Python, Databricks, Excel, or similar technologies.
 ·        Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
 ·        Experience driving process improvement, automation, AI-enabled analytics, and digital transformation initiatives in a complex business environment.
 ·        Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and analytics/reporting solutions
 ·        Strong stakeholder management, communication skills, and Continuous improvement mindset
 ·        Rapid Response experience
 ·        Good-to-have: Pharma domain experience
 
 
 
.

jobs.title: Specialist IS Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Information Systems 
 Job Description 
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 
 In this vital role, you will work as part of a Product Team focusing on the Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN) and Instrument Data Acquisition Platform , accelerating Amgen’s product development and commercial manufacturing. You will collaborate with a dynamic, globally distributed team of technical product owners, business analysts, test/validation engineers , project managers, and scrum masters on the design, development, validation, support, and continuous optimization of Amgen Operations’ ELN ecosystem. This role requires strong hands-on experience with enterprise platform and application testing in a GxP-regulated environment , including CSV/CSA activities , to ensure systems meet regulatory, quality, and data integrity standards. In addition, the role demands significant experience in Application Support and Maintenance (AMS) , including incident management, release support, upgrades, patches, and operational stability of mission-critical laboratory platforms. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in ELN applications, enterprise application integration, end-to-end data and process harmonization , and the seamless integration of laboratory instrument data with enterprise systems (e.g., LIMS, CDS, MES, data platforms). Success in this role requires comfort working in a matrixed, global organization , balancing innovation with compliance, operational excellence, and system reliability.
 
 Software Engineering & Platform Ownership
 Possess strong software development skills and rapidly translate concepts into working, production-ready solutions
 Conduct code reviews to ensure quality, security, performance, and adherence to enterprise standards
 Create and maintain documentation for architecture, design, validation, deployment, disaster recovery, and operations 
 Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical challenges across integrated enterprise platforms
 Stay current with emerging technologies, industry best practices, and regulated system development trends
 
 GxP Testing, Validation & Quality
 Lead and contribute to enterprise application testing in GxP environments , ensuring compliance with FDA, EMA, and global regulatory requirements
 Own and execute CSV/CSA activities , including risk assessments, test strategy, IQ/OQ/PQ (or equivalent), traceability, and validation documentation
 Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, and test scripts for system enhancements, patches, upgrades, and vendor releases
 Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure changes do not negatively impact validated functionality
 Partner with Quality, Validation, and Business teams to support audits, inspections, and validation lifecycle activities
 
 Application Support & Maintenance (AMS)
 Provide Level 2 / Level 3 application support for ELN and associated enterprise platforms
 Manage incident, problem, and change processes , including P1/P2 incident response and root cause analysis
 Support production releases, vendor upgrades, hotfixes, and patches , ensuring minimal disruption to business operations
 Work within ITIL-based processes using ServiceNow for incident, change, and problem management
 Collaborate with infrastructure, vendor, and business partners to resolve operational bottlenecks and systemic issues
 Ensure platform stability, performance monitoring, and operational readiness in regulated environments
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery
 Work closely with product teams, business partners, validation, quality, data scientists, and vendors
 Drive system enhancements, bug fixes, and continuous improvements across the platform landscape
 Develop and implement business process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness
 Effectively operate within large, diverse, and globally dispersed teams in a matrixed organization
 Leverage AI and automation to streamline testing, support workflows, and operational processes
 
 Basic Qualifications
 Bachelor s OR Master’s degree with 8–12 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Science, or Machine Learning Engineering
 
 Functional Skills
 
 Must-Have Skills
 Strong experience with enterprise application testing in GxP-regulated environments 
 Hands-on experience with CSV/CSA validation methodologies and documentation 
 Software engineering best practices: Git, CI/CD (Jenkins, Maven), automated testing
 Experience supporting enterprise platforms with issue ticketing and customer-facing support models 
 Proven experience in Application Support & Maintenance (AMS) for regulated systems
 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 Incident response experience, including P1/P2 production incidents 
 Experience with ServiceNow, ITIL processes, and change management workflows 
 Ability to translate vendor capabilities and constraints into business-aligned solutions
 Scripting and automation for server and operational task automation
 Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) to improve productivity and workflows
 
 Good-to-Have Skills
 Strong customer focus with the ability to partner closely with business stakeholders
 Experience supporting 200 servers or large-scale enterprise platforms
 Experience with Smartsheets, Excel, Tableau, Spotfire
 Ability to work independently with strong analytical and written communication skills
 
 
 Professional Certifications
 SAFe for Teams certification (preferred)
 
 Soft Skills
 Strong leadership, transformation, and change management capabilities
 Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, regulated environment
 Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
 High degree of initiative, accountability, and self-motivation
 
 
 
 
.

jobs.title: Intercompany Accounting Analyst
jobs.description:
At Ecolab, you can help take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, delivering critical insights and innovative solutions to help our customers achieve clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments. With our worldwide reach and ambitious growth plans, you will have the opportunity to own your future and impact what matters. Are you ready to make an impact?
 
 Ecolab is searching for a driven Intercompany Accounting Analyst for future opportunities within our Finance division in Pune, India . The Intercompany Accounting Analyst is responsible for end-to-end processing of intercompany invoices in SAP, including both PO-based and non-PO-based transactions & Global reporting. This requires expertise in Excel & SAP T-codes for invoice posting and reversals ensuring accuracy and comply with DTP, policies, procedures and deadlines.
 
 What’s in it For You: 
 You will join a growth company offering a competitive salary and benefits. 
 The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.
 The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives and ideas to achieve our best.
 Feel proud each day to work for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments.
 
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Post intercompany invoices and journal entries in SAP for cross-company transactions.
 Ensure accurate coding and documentation of invoices in compliance with internal policies.
 Monitor and resolve pending invoice requests and discrepancies.
 Update various reports with current month-end information
 Manage ERP and technologies tools like SAP, Service now, OnBase, & HFM tool etc.
 Respond to queries related to invoice status, reversals, and payment purpose codes.
 Understand and apply Withholding Tax rules relevant to intercompany transactions.
 Take full and proactive ownership of issues and queries.
 Ensure correct selection and usage of Intercompany GL accounts during invoice posting to reflect accurate financial reporting.
 Maintain fluid communication with stakeholders and other GBS teams.
 Collaborate with Team Leads and Senior analysts in the planning, development, and implementation of projects.
 Support Team Leads in preparation of trainings and in the detection of training opportunities.
 Assist and train Junior Analysts in their daily work
 Basic knowledge of how mismatches occur between two entities books.
 Elimination process at month-ends complying with SOX 801.
 
 
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Degree in Accounting or Finance and two to four years’ experience.
 Advanced English level (oral and writing).
 Proficient in Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, etc.) and other Microsoft tools.
 Strong command over all  SAP T-codes used in Accounts Payable , especially for invoice processing, reversals, etc.
 Knowledge of Blackline, Oracle and Power BI will be a plus.
 
 
 Skills: 
 
 Ability to meet month-end close and other timeline
 Good analytical and problem-solving skills
 Good communication and interpersonal skills
 Good interpersonal skills - attention to detail
 Team-focused, results oriented
 Ability to work with deadlines, under pressure with a track record of delivery.
 Flexible and Open for All RTR IC work
 
 
 A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $14 billion, employs more than 47,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The company delivers comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use. Ecolab’s innovative solutions improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets. www.ecolab.com
 
 Follow us on LinkedIn Ecolab, Twitter Ecolab, Instagram Ecolab_Inc and Facebook Ecolab.

jobs.title: Director, Analytics Engineering (2 Openings)
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary 
#LI-Remote Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Engineering. This role is responsible for building next-generation, AI-powered automated data pipelines and scalable data repositories that enable enterprise data science and analytics at scale. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, modern data engineering tools, and feature engineering platforms, this director creates self-service, analytics-ready datasets and enterprise feature stores that empower both expert data scientists and citizen data scientists to rapidly develop, deploy, and scale models. This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel. There are 2 positions available.  
 Job Description 
 Major accountabilities: 
 Design and implement intelligent, self-healing data pipelines that leverage AI/ML for automated data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation.
 Build and maintain centralized feature stores that enable feature reusability across multiple models and use cases.
 Create curated data repositories optimized for data science/AI workflows, including training datasets, evaluation datasets, and production serving layers.
 Develop automated feature engineering pipelines that transform raw data into analytics-ready features with lineage tracking.
 Partner with Enterprise IT to optimize analytics platform architecture for high-performance data science workloads.
 Build automated pipelines that integrate diverse data sources including sales, CRM, patient claims, real-world evidence, and unstructured data.
 Create self-service data access layers that empower data scientists and analysts to query and extract data independently.
 Establish SLAs for data availability, freshness, and quality; implement monitoring and observability solutions.
 
 Essential Requirements 
 Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field;
 7 years of experience in data engineering, ML/AI engineering, or analytics infrastructure.
 5 years leading teams building enterprise-scale data platforms and feature stores.
 Expert knowledge of feature store technologies (Feast, Tecton, SageMaker Feature Store, Databricks Feature Store).
 Deep expertise in modern data platforms optimized for ML workloads (Databricks, Auto ML, Snowflake, BigQuery).

jobs.title: Compliance Auditor x3
jobs.description:
Compliance Auditor x3 Location: Manchester - Remote This role involves significant international travel (50–60%) across global manufacturing sites and operational facilities. 
  
 As a Corporate Compliance Auditor, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding Lonza’s license to operate by driving compliance excellence and mitigating quality risks worldwide. Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will design, plan, and execute high-impact corporate cGMP audits across a diverse global footprint—spanning biologics, cell and gene therapies, sterile drug products, APIs, medical devices, and hardware/software operations.
 In this high-visibility global role, you will partner directly with manufacturing sites to elevate standards, navigate complex regulatory landscapes, and ensure continuous inspection readiness.
   
 What you will get:   
 An agile career and dynamic working culture
 An inclusive and ethical workplace
 A variety of benefits tailored to your localality.
 Access to global benefits via https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits 
   
 What you will do: 
  
 Champion Global Excellence: Support the global vision and strategic objectives for HR processes and technology, ensuring alignment with Lonza’s goals.
 Advise and support sites in developing and executing remediation actions, preparing for and managing regulatory inspections, and ensuring compliance. 
 Provide GMP compliance expertise and best practice guidance. 
 Perform Supplier Quality assessments and audits. 
 Act as SPOC for assigned suppliers within a global portfolio. 
 Monitor and assess compliance risks across business units. 
 Mentor and coach auditors
   
   
 What we are looking for: 
   
 Mandatory previous experience as a Health Authority Inspector with the MHRA or HPRA (Ireland) carrying out cGMP inspections.
 Lead, plan, and execute global corporate cGMP compliance audits across diverse sites, including biologics, cell/gene therapies, sterile products, and APIs.
 Advise sites on regulatory compliance, risk assessment, remediation strategies, and health authority inspection preparation.
 Perform supplier assessments and act as the global Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for assigned suppliers.
 Mentor junior auditors, provide senior compliance guidance, and drive continuous quality improvement across business units.
 10 years of cGMP QA/auditing experience paired with an MSc (or equivalent) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy, or a related field.
   
   
 About Lonza 
 At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30 sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
 Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
 Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.title: Epidemiology Analyst
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Research 
 Job Description 
 Do you want an exciting position working with multiple teams to generate real world evidence supporting a wide variety of business needs?  
 Amgen focuses on areas of high unmet medical need and leverages its expertise to strive for solutions that improve health outcomes and dramatically improve people’s lives. A biotechnology pioneer since 1980, Amgen has grown to be one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies, has reached millions of patients around the world, and is developing a pipeline of medicines with breakaway potential.
 Observational Research is an increasingly important component in drug development and commercialization. There is increased demand for information from Real-World Data (RWD) studies for regulatory and reimbursement authorities. The Center for Observational Research (CfOR) at Amgen partners with teams to generate real world evidence for multiple stakeholders across the product lifecycle. CfOR studies include but are not limited to evidence generation regarding the frequency and distribution of disease, the clinical burden of disease, the natural history or clinical course of disease, the design of clinical trials, treatment cost and utilization patterns, and the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic interventions. ​
 Amgen is seeking an Epidemiology Analyst (RWD researcher) to join our CfOR organization based in Hyderabad, India. In this role, the individual will contribute to research activities in the Data and Analytics Center (DAC) on functionally aligned teams. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of observational research methodology, excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work across various therapeutic areas and regions. The Epidemiology Analyst is recognized as a strong scientific contributor and is a first or contributing author for papers in peer-reviewed journals, abstracts for scientific congresses or for internal reports that enhance the company’s mission. 
 Key Activities include:
 Contribute to global observational research activities for CfOR in support of drug development, registration, and commercialization across Amgen’s portfolio of products
 Contribute to the implementation and conduct of observational studies to support the product lifecycle using real world databases and analytics platforms (e.g., Atlas, Aetion, and other internal/external RWD tools)
 Develop, review, and maintain high-quality medical codelists for exposures, outcomes, covariates, and safety endpoints using standard coding systems (e.g., ICD, MedDRA, SNOMED, RxNorm), ensuring clinical validity and regulatory readiness
 Partner with study team members to ensure codelists are fit-for-purpose, transparent, and reproducible across studies
 Executes/manages descriptive epidemiologic studies to characterize the incidence/prevalence of disease in US, EU, Asia, and emerging market countries
 Executes/manages research projects involving the analysis of multiple types of data including medical claims, electronic health records, and prospective observational cohort studies
 Provides safety research support across the life cycle of Amgen products, supports the development of risk management plans, and executes pharmacovigilance studies
 Conducts literature reviews and prepares research reports and scientific manuscripts
 Stays abreast of the latest developments in the field of observational research and drug development
 Promotes awareness, understanding, and use of observational research methods
 Communicates significant scientific information to a variety of audiences
 Preferred Qualifications:
 MBBS (or equivalent) and/or PhD training in Epidemiology or other subject with high observational research content
 Experience in the design, execution, and analysis of observational research studies within Pharmaceutical or Public Health setting
 Advanced expertise in medical codelist construction, maintenance, and quality assurance across standard clinical coding systems (e.g., ICD, MedDRA, SNOMED)
 Experience in research to support drug development
 Experience working with secondary data systems, including administrative claims, EMR, registries
 Experience in observational research project planning and management
 Excellent verbal and writing communication and interpersonal skills
 Experience working in multi-disciplinary teams
 
 Basic Qualifications:
 Master s degree with 8 to 13 years of experience
 
 
 
.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Data Modeling/analytics
jobs.description:
Career Category 
Information Systems 
 Job Description 
 Job Description 
 ABOUT AMGEN  
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today. 
 ABOUT THE ROLE  
 Role Description:  
 As the Senior Associate Data Scientist at Amgen, you will be responsible for developing and deploying advanced machine learning models. This role will support the development of statistical, Bayesian, causal, and machine learning models that enhance forecasting capabilities and quantify uncertainty to guide decision-making across the company. The position is well suited to a curious and collaborative problem solver who is excited about applying forecasting methods, complex datasets, and modern analytical tools to build decision-support solutions that inform planning and business decision-making.
 Roles & Responsibilities:   
 Analyze large, complex datasets using statistical modeling, forecasting, and analytics techniques to generate insights that support business decision-making.
 Support the development of simulation and scenario-analysis capabilities to better understand the data
 Contribute across the modeling lifecycle, including business problem framing, exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment support, monitoring, and explainability.
 Collaborate with senior team members to evaluate and apply new tools and methodologies in forecasting, data science, and AI to business problems.
 Communicate analytical findings and model results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Ensure models are trained with the latest data and meet the SLA expectations 
 Work with a global cross functional team on the AI tool’s road map
 Work in technical teams in development, deployment, and application of applied analytics, predictive analytics, and prescriptive analytics.
 Utilize technical skills such as hypothesis testing, machine learning and retrieval processes to apply statistical and data mining techniques to identify trends, create figures, and analyze other relevant information.
 Perform exploratory and targeted data analyses using descriptive statistics and other methods.
 Model/analytics experiment and development pipeline leveraging MLOps.
 Collaborate with technical teams to translate the business needs into technical specifications, particularly focusing on AI-driven automation and insights.
 Develop and integrate custom applications, intelligent dashboards, and automated workflows that incorporate AI capabilities to enhance decision-making and efficiency.
 Basic Qualifications:  
 Master’s OR Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 4 years and maximum of 7 years of Information Systems experience. 
 Must-Have Skills
 Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis, statistical modeling, and automation.
 Hands-on experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, and forecasting models.
 Solid knowledge of statistics, including hypothesis testing, descriptive statistics, and experimental analysis.
 Experience across the end-to-end model lifecycle: data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and explainability.
 Ability to work with large and complex datasets using data-mining and analytical techniques.
 Familiarity with MLOps practices, including model pipelines, versioning, deployment support, retraining, and performance monitoring.
 Experience building simulation or scenario-analysis models.
 Ability to translate business problems into technical requirements and analytical solutions.
 Experience developing AI-enabled dashboards, automated workflows, or data applications.
 Strong stakeholder communication skills—able to explain insights and model outcomes to both technical and business audiences.
 Experience working in cross-functional, global technical teams.
 
 Good-to-Have Skills:  
 Experience in MLOps practices and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow); Experience in DevOps tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD) 
 Proficiency in Python and relevant ML libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) 
 Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills; Ability to learn quickly; Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
 Experience with data engineering and pipeline development 
 Knowledge of NLP techniques for text analysis and sentiment analysis 
 Experience in analyzing time-series data for forecasting and trend analysis 
 Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud 
 Experience with Databricks platform for data analytics and MLOps 
 Professional Certifications :  
 Any AWS Developer certification (preferred) 
 Any Python and ML certification (preferred) 
 Soft Skills:  
 Initiative to explore alternate technology and approaches to solving problems. 
 Skilled in breaking down problems, documenting problem statements, and estimating efforts. 
 Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills. 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills 
 Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams 
 High degree of initiative and self-motivation. 
 Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.  
 Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals

 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. 
 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Job Title: Analyst - Commercial Pharma Analytics
 GCL:C3
 Introduction to role:
 Are you ready to turn complex healthcare data into decisions that accelerate brand growth and improve patient outcomes? As an Analyst in Pharmaceutical Commercial Analytics based in Chennai, you will serve as a proactive internal consultant to a specific brand team, crafting and delivering commercial analytics. These analytics help drive strategic and operational excellence. Your work will enable data-driven decisions grounded in rigorous analysis and the best available information, directly influencing how we engage customers, allocate resources, and measure impact.
 You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Medical, Market Access, Sales, Forecasting, and other partners to build forward-looking and actionable solutions across customer segmentation and targeting, HCP and patient opportunity identification, test-and-learn experiments, market simulation, and patient flow modelling. Imagine seeing your insights shape go-to-market strategies within weeks, and your capabilities embedded across the enterprise—how will you leave your mark?
 Accountabilities:
 Commercial Decision Support: Provide rigorous analytics to guide brand strategy and resourcing decisions, focusing on customer-facing model leadership and measurable business impact.
 Segmentation and Targeting: Build and implement HCP and patient grouping and selection approaches; identify high-value opportunities to improve coverage, conversion, and growth.
 Predictive and Prescriptive Analytics: Build, test, and operationalize models using syndicated and custom, primary and secondary data (including IQVIA) to inform decisions and actions.
 Experimentation and Simulation: Lead smart business experiments (test and learn), market analysis simulations, and patient movement modelling to de-risk decisions and accelerate learning.
 Data Access and Integration: Access and integrate large, transactional datasets via platforms and tools such as DataBricks, PySpark, Python, R, and SQL; ensure quality and reproducibility.
 Insight Communication: Summarize and present findings through clear narratives, visualizations, and concise recommendations that influence senior collaborators and drive action.
 Capability Building: Identify, prioritize, and lead the development, deployment, and embedding of new analytic capabilities; instill a culture of continuous improvement.
 Partnership and Influence: Build trusted relationships with cross-functional partners; translate technical solutions into business value and shared outcomes.
 External Scanning: Monitor the external analytics landscape within and beyond pharma; evaluate and adapt leading methods and technologies for practical use inside the organization.
 Essential Skills/Experience:
 A quantitative Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience from an accredited college or university is required. It must be in Engineering, Operations Research, Management Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred (Master’s, MBA or PhD).
 3 years of experience in application of advanced methods and statistical procedures on large and disparate datasets.
 3 years of recent experience and proficiency with PySpark, Python, R, SQL.
 Working knowledge of data visualization – PowerBI, MicroStrategy, Tableau, Qlikview, D3js or similar tools.
 Working knowledge on platforms like DataBricks.
 Experience with IQVIA data sets.
 - Experience in MS Office products - Excel and PowerPoint skills required.
 Expertise in managing and analyzing a range of large, transactional databases is required.
 Statistical analysis and modelling background is advantageous
 ML a plus
 Ability to derive, summarize and communicate insights from analyses.
 Organization and time management skills.
 Desirable Skills/Experience:
 Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with a significant number of business leaders and cross-functional business partners.
 Strong communication and influencing skills with demonstrated ability to develop and effectively present succinct, compelling reviews of independently developed analyses infused with insight and business implications/actions to be considered.
 Strategic and critical thinking with the ability to engage, build and maintain credibility with Commercial Leadership Team.
 Knowledge of AZ brand and Science (Oncology in particular).
 Experience using Big Data, is a plus. Exposure to SPARK is desirable.
 Should have Excellent Analytical, Problem-Solving ability. Should be able to grasp new concepts quickly
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold ideas fueled by the power to encourage life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That s why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn t mean we re not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
 Why AstraZeneca:
 Here, you will connect cutting-edge analytics with a clear purpose—transforming the lives of patients with unmet needs. You will join a collaborative, high-performing community that pairs data scientists with marketers, clinicians, and technologists to solve real problems at pace. We invest in modern platforms, embrace predictive analytics and smart automation, and encourage curiosity and initiative alongside kindness and support. Your expertise will help power a digitally evolving enterprise, creating solutions that free our scientists to discover more and our brands to deliver better outcomes for patients and society.

 Seize the opportunity to turn data into decisive action that shapes brand strategy and improves patient outcomes—submit your application today and help build what comes next!

jobs.title: R&D Scientific Competitive Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
About the job 
 Our Team: 
 The Global R&D Strategy and Portfolio Management team’s overarching objective is to equip Sanofi’s leaders with robust, objective and externally focused insights and recommendations they need to make better informed R&D strategy, and portfolio and project investment decisions to ensure pipeline sustainability.
 We achieve this by (1) delivering a comprehensive R&D strategy positioning the organization to embrace future opportunities and challenges, driving sustained success (2) ensuring a sustainable portfolio strategy, robust valuation and prioritization of the R&D portfolio and optimization of resources, high quality pipeline reporting, benchmarking, and scientific competitive intelligence (3) ensuring high quality investment governance incorporating decision quality and thoughtful risk taking principles.
 As part of the R&D Portfolio Strategy and Management team, the Competitive Intelligence group works with key stakeholders across the organization (R&D and GBUs) to deliver robust external competitive intelligence insights and ensure data-driven decision-making.
 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced  IP Competitive Intelligence Analyst  to join our offshore hub in India. In this role, you will leverage patent data as a strategic source of competitive and technological intelligence. You will analyze innovation trends, competitor R&D directions, and emerging technologies to support early- and mid-stage pipeline decisions, strategic R&D and innovation decisions. This role focuses on identifying strategic insights from patent activity to inform R&D and business strategy. You will leverage patent data as a strategic source of competitive and technological intelligence.
 Main responsibilities 
 Use patent data and other scientific sources to provide a comprehensive and insightful view of the competitive innovation landscape and competition to Sanofi programs.
 Collaborate with CI Senior Analyst, CI Leaders and Portfolio Strategy teams to interpret the strategic implications of competitors’ IP activity and communicate key insights to R&D stakeholders.
 Deliver high-impact CI deliverables such as patent landscapes, innovation trend analyses, technology benchmarking, and competitor watchlists.
 Monitor key competitors’ patenting activity to identify shifts in R&D focus, emerging technologies, technology trends . 
 Support Global Project Teams by providing timely and relevant patent-based intelligence aligned with therapeutic or technological priorities.
 Work closely with Scientific CI, Portfolio Management to ensure consistency and integration of insights.
 Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of digital and AI tools for patent analytics and competitive monitoring.

 Experience:  3 years of experience in pharmaceuticals/healthcare industry, specifically within innovative pharma. ≥1 year of experience in Competitive Intelligence, technology scouting, or patent analytics within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry or a CI agency in conducting analysis and surveillance of R&D assets (R&D pipelines, technology platforms, or innovation trends) using patent data.

 Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., PowerPoint, Excel, Tableau).
 
 Education: Master degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field (M Pharma, PharmD, or equivalent).

jobs.title: SAM Analyst
jobs.description:
About the job 
   
 Our Team: 
 The Software Asset Management team is part of the Digital Strategy and Operations department within Sanofi. 
 Our mission is to ensure software assets are governed and monitored throughout their lifecycle within our organization to ensure proper governance, optimize investments, maintain compliance with licensing agreements, and enhance security across all business units globally. 
 The SAM team operates globally, covering all Sanofi business units (R&D, industrial, commercial, support functions) across all geographies, with strong partnerships with Procurement, Legal, and IT teams. 
   
 We have successfully implemented the ServiceNow SAM Pro module to monitor complex software license compliance for key vendors, historically supported through a Managed Service. We are now transitioning away from this Managed Service and internalizing this capability, initially focusing on Microsoft, Oracle, and TIBCO publishers. This role will focus specifically on Oracle and TIBCO, working alongside a teammate covering Microsoft. 
 In parallel, we are developing new SAM tools leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Agile mode, to automate existing processes and create innovative ones.

Your primary focus will be to support the internalization of our ServiceNow SAM Pro capability; as we mature, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the design and development of innovative tools.

 IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

 Experience with flavour, fragrance, food, beverage or consumer-product analysis.

 Exposure to sensory evaluation, olfactive assessment or taste description.
